exact_blockers.required_action: Stage the exact NeuralKalmanAHS and AHS_2023 source at immutable 40-hex revisions with reviewed license text and per-file SHA-256 manifests; never reconstruct source from the paper description.
exact_blockers.statement: The pinned note records README/demo HTML, CSS and audio only for the public repositories, with no source implementation, no revision, no tree digest, no file count and no license text.

exact_blockers.required_action: Provide each variant's exact trained checkpoint with byte count, SHA-256, model card, training revision and the covariance/reference configuration; never invent weights, a network or a controller.
exact_blockers.statement: No trained covariance-variant or reference-variant checkpoint, model card, Kalman covariance configuration, network structure or canonical model/config digest exists locally.

exact_blockers.required_action: Pin the runtime, loader, offline path and exact geometry for both variants with install/import parity and a finite drain/reset path.
exact_blockers.statement: No hash-pinned runtime, checkpoint loader, offline load path, interactive harness or declared candidate geometry exists.

exact_blockers.required_action: Freeze a rights-cleared matched cohort with held-out speakers/paths and exact loop metadata before any comparison.
exact_blockers.statement: No rights-cleared matched closed-loop cohort with loop gain, delay, saturation, noise, reset schedule and held-out speakers/paths exists; the local feedback pilot is a classical-controller screen, not a NeuralKalmanAHS cohort.

exact_blockers.required_action: Run the frozen DSP matrix on both pinned variants and retain every failure and nonfinite case.
exact_blockers.statement: The DSP profile requires sweeps, steps, impulses, silence, clean speech and a task-specific control with gain, response, attack/release, headroom, delay, numerical behavior, state transitions and interacting nonlinear configurations; none was run because no candidate instance exists.

exact_blockers.required_action: Record reviewed rights and obtain independent exact-head review before opening any opt-in, default-off adapter.
exact_blockers.statement: Source, checkpoint, training-data, cohort and output rights are unrecorded, and no independent exact-head review or opt-in adapter decision exists.

required_artifacts.required: The exact NeuralKalmanAHS and AHS_2023 implementation at immutable 40-hex revisions, including the covariance and reference integration entry points, reviewed upstream license text, per-file SHA-256 manifests, file counts and tree digests.

The trained checkpoint bytes for each covariance and reference variant with SHA-256, byte count, model card, training provenance, architecture, STFT/frame/hop geometry, Kalman state and covariance configuration, parameter count, precision and reset policy, plus a canonical per-variant model/config digest.
A hash-pinned inference runtime and streaming harness with install/import parity, a checkpoint loader, finite drain, reset and the exact sample-rate/frame/hop geometry for both variants.

A rights-cleared closed-loop cohort with frozen speech, measured or frozen loudspeaker-to-microphone paths, loop gain, delay, saturation, noise, reset schedule, held-out speakers/paths and target-speech/reference truth.

A frozen DSP protocol and result bundle for sweeps, steps, impulses, silence, clean speech, gain, response, attack/release, headroom, delay, numerical behavior, state transitions and interacting nonlinear configurations on the exact pinned candidate.
Reviewed source, checkpoint, training-data, corpus and derived-output rights, including redistribution scope and any participant or device terms.
An independent exact-head review of source, checkpoints, runtime, rights, cohort, covariance/reference distinction, an opt-in default-off adapter decision and a complete release package.
